packet.headline_seed: Novak Djokovic has a new job — advisor to private equity firm General Atlantic
packet.description_seed: General Atlantic has tapped tennis legend Novak Djokovic to serve as a global strategic advisor.

what: Novak Djokovic has a new job — advisor to private equity firm General Atlantic

clean_source_blocks.text: General Atlantic has tapped tennis legend Novak Djokovic to serve as a global strategic advisor, where, according to a press release, he “will work closely with the firm’s leadership, portfolio companies, and investors, bringing perspectives on leadership, resilience, and innovation that reflect General Atlantic’s commitment to excellence.” The news comes just days before Djokovic is set to play at Wimbledon, with his eyes set on a 25th Grand Slam title. The partnership, in many ways, makes sense. Djokovic has invested in a handful of wellness companies, including Waterdrop in 2023, and co-founded his own supplement company, SILA, in 2024, followed by the clean snack food company Cob Foods in 2025. He also backed the wearables company Incrediwear. As reported by Bloomberg, General Atlantic hopes to leverage Djokovic’s network to gain further exposure to the health and wellness sector. ---
General Atlantic has tapped tennis legend Novak Djokovic to serve as a global strategic advisor.

Novak Djokovic is preparing to compete once more at Wimbledon as he searches for that elusive 25th Grand Slam title. However, away from the court he is also making moves after the 39-year-old joined General Atlantic. He will take up a new role as global strategic advisor for the firm who in turn have a large minority stake in Grupo Aguilas. They are the organisation that invests in Mexican Liga MX’s Club America and the familiar Azteca Stadium. That stadium is very much in the current news with the World Cup featuring there. One of the most prominent venues, the scenic mountains overlooking the splendid facilities will host a number of matches in the World Cup and has in the past gone viral over its location in Mexico.

With a capacity of 88,000, there is a chance we could see England take on Mexico, who have never lost there, in the latter stages of the World Cup if things go to plan. Going back to Djokovic, and his arrival has been warmly met. “Novak’s discipline, tenacity, and drive have defined his career at the highest level of competition," Bill Ford, chairman and chief executive of General Atlantic, said. “He brings a global perspective and a commitment to continuous growth that aligns deeply with our culture and values. We are thrilled to welcome Novak to the General Atlantic team and look forward to partnering with him to create enduring value for our clients and portfolio companies.”

original_article.research:
[Lähde: TechCrunch]
General Atlantic has tapped tennis legend Novak Djokovic to serve as a global strategic advisor, where, according to a press release, he “will work closely with the firm’s leadership, portfolio companies, and investors, bringing perspectives on leadership, resilience, and innovation that reflect General Atlantic’s commitment to excellence.”

The news comes just days before Djokovic is set to play at Wimbledon, with his eyes set on a 25th Grand Slam title. The partnership, in many ways, makes sense. Djokovic has invested in a handful of wellness companies, including Waterdrop in 2023, and co-founded his own supplement company, SILA, in 2024, followed by the clean snack food company Cob Foods in 2025. He also backed the wearables company Incrediwear. As reported by Bloomberg, General Atlantic hopes to leverage Djokovic’s network to gain further exposure to the health and wellness sector.

---

[Lähde: Yardbarker]
Novak Djokovic is preparing to compete once more at Wimbledon as he searches for that elusive 25th Grand Slam title. However, away from the court he is also making moves after the 39-year-old joined General Atlantic.

He will take up a new role as global strategic advisor for the firm who in turn have a large minority stake in Grupo Aguilas. They are the organisation that invests in Mexican Liga MX’s Club America and the familiar Azteca Stadium.

That stadium is very much in the current news with the World Cup featuring there. One of the most prominent venues, the scenic mountains overlooking the splendid facilities will host a number of matches in the World Cup and has in the past gone viral over its location in Mexico.

With a capacity of 88,000, there is a chance we could see England take on Mexico, who have never lost there, in the latter stages of the World Cup if things go to plan.

Going back to Djokovic, and his arrival has been warmly met. “Novak’s discipline, tenacity, and drive have defined his career at the highest level of competition," Bill Ford, chairman and chief executive of General Atlantic, said.

“He brings a global perspective and a commitment to continuous growth that aligns deeply with our culture and values. We are thrilled to welcome Novak to the General Atlantic team and look forward to partnering with him to create enduring value for our clients and portfolio companies.”

The Serbian is excited to take a big step into the world of investing. With his tennis career surely coming to an end in the coming years, he will be looking for more opportunities outside of the sport to spend his time.

He is excited and motivated to join the company. “General Atlantic has spent decades backing founders who refuse to accept the limits others set for them – that instinct resonates deeply with me," he commented.

“The principles that drive performance at the highest level of sport are the same ones that build great businesses: discipline, long-term thinking, and the courage to keep improving. I look forward to contributing to the next chapter of what Bill and the team are building.”

Djokovic and Ford first met at the 2023 French Open, and have presumably kept close ties since with this new partnership allowing Djokovic to make his Wall Street debut.

payload.title: Novak Djokovicista tulee General Atlanticin strateginen neuvonantaja
payload.summary: Tennistähti Novak Djokovic on nimitetty pääomasijoitusyhtiö General Atlanticin globaaliksi strategiseksi neuvonantajaksi. Yhtiö hakee hänen kokemuksestaan ja verkostoistaan tukea erityisesti hyvinvointialan suuntaan.
payload.content:
Novak Djokovic aloittaa uutena globaalina strategisena neuvonantajana pääomasijoitusyhtiö General Atlanticissa juuri ennen Wimbledonia, jossa hän tavoittelee uransa 25:tä Grand Slam -mestaruutta. Tehtävässä hänen on määrä työskennellä yhtiön johdon, sijoituskohteiden ja sijoittajien kanssa sekä tuoda mukaan näkökulmia johtamisesta, sinnikkyydestä ja innovaatioista.

## Uusi rooli kentän ulkopuolella

Nimitys tuo 39-vuotiaalle Djokovicille uuden näkyvän tehtävän urheilu-uran rinnalle. General Atlanticin mukaan hänen roolinsa liittyy yhtiön sitoutumiseen huippuosaamiseen, ja yhteistyössä painottuvat kokemukset, joita Djokovic on kerännyt pitkällä urallaan kansainvälisen kilpailun korkeimmalla tasolla.

General Atlanticin puheenjohtaja ja toimitusjohtaja Bill Ford sanoi Djokovicin kurinalaisuuden, sitkeyden ja määrätietoisuuden määrittäneen hänen uraansa. Fordin mukaan Djokovic tuo yhtiöön globaalin näkökulman ja jatkuvaan kasvuun liittyvän ajattelutavan, joka sopii General Atlanticin kulttuuriin ja arvoihin. Yhtiö odottaa yhteistyötä asiakkaidensa ja sijoituskohteidensa hyväksi.

## Hyvinvointiala korostuu taustalla

Djokovicin valinta liittyy myös hänen aiempaan toimintaansa hyvinvointi- ja terveystuotteiden parissa. Hän sijoitti Waterdropiin vuonna 2023, oli mukana perustamassa SILA-ravintolisäyhtiötä vuonna 2024 ja Cob Foods -välipalabrändiä vuonna 2025. Lisäksi hän on tukenut puettavan teknologian yhtiötä Incrediwearia.

General Atlanticin kerrotaan tavoittelevan Djokovicin verkostojen avulla lisää näkyvyyttä terveys- ja hyvinvointisektorilla. Tämä tekee nimityksestä luontevan jatkon hänen yrityskytköksilleen, sillä lähteissä korostuvat sekä hänen sijoituksensa hyvinvointiyhtiöihin että hänen kansainvälinen asemansa urheilun ulkopuolella.

## Yhtiöllä on myös urheilukytköksiä

General Atlanticilla on suuri vähemmistöosuus Grupo Aguilasissa, joka sijoittaa meksikolaiseen Liga MX -seura Club Américaan ja Azteca-stadioniin. Azteca on ajankohtainen myös tulevan jalkapallon MM-turnauksen vuoksi: 88 000 katsojan stadion isännöi useita otteluita ja kuuluu kilpailun näkyvimpiin tapahtumapaikkoihin.

Yhtiö aikoo hyödyntää hänen kokemustaan, johtajuusnäkökulmiaan ja kansainvälisiä verkostojaan.
Djokovicilla on aiempia sijoituksia ja yrityshankkeita hyvinvointi- ja terveystuotteiden parissa.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu annettuihin lähdeblokkeihin. Azteca-stadioniin ja Grupo Aguilasiin liittyvä taustatieto pidettiin rajattuna, koska jutun ydin on Djokovicin uusi neuvonantajarooli.
